role: usage evidence source for the usage-burndown dispatch engine
consequence: degrades: bin/fm-dispatch-select.sh retains the selected profile with quota_posture=unknown when evidence is missing, so a break misroutes rather than halts

upstream.license: MIT; retained in the seed tree
upstream.write_access: none (push=false); a public GitHub fork GRyndStone/quota-axi exists - see docs/folding-tools.md 'The fork question'

ours.status: PROPOSED - not created; repository creation is the captain's outward-facing call

build.note: the npm scope is reserved, not published; scope ownership is what makes an upstream package unable to occupy our name

install.rationale: matches the GRyndStone/no-mistakes precedent; deliberately NOT an npm global prefix, so `npm i -g` cannot reach our binary at all

replacementVectors: npm install -g quota-axi (reclaims the upstream binary name in the npm prefix)
a fresh machine setup that installs the published package

carriedFixes.summary: derive every Grok window's windowSeconds from the decoded current-period boundaries instead of decoding the period, using it for validation, and discarding it
carriedFixes.whyItMatters: without windowSeconds, bin/fm-usage-source-lib.sh falls through to default_secs(), which returns 0 for every Grok window id, so the window is dropped and Grok reports evidence:unknown

carriedFixes.summary: restore the published normalized product ids product:grokbuild and product:grokimagine
carriedFixes.upstreamState: renamed upstream between 0.1.5 and 0.1.13 to grok_build / imagine
carriedFixes.whyItMatters: a silent contract break: a consumer keyed on the published ids reads nothing, with no error and no failed exit

measuredUsage.method: grep over bin/ for every quota-axi invocation
measuredUsage.note: firstmate's ENTIRE quota dependency is one command producing one JSON shape (.providers[].windows[]); see bin/fm-dispatch-select.sh:291

trim.keep: --json output path and the claude, codex, grok, cursor, copilot provider decoders
trim.why: bin/fm-usage-source-lib.sh registers exactly these five as quota-axi-metered

trim.drop: kimi provider and its credential helpers (kimi.ts, kimi-code-cli-credential.ts, pi-kimi-credential.ts)
trim.why: not in fm_usage_source_registry; firstmate never meters kimi
trim.burden_removed: 1333 of 4680 provider LOC (28%), including two credential-discovery paths that read local auth stores

trim.drop: human render/TOON dashboard, advice, and interpretation-hint surfaces
trim.why: firstmate consumes --json only; the human surfaces have zero firstmate callers
firstmate loads its own skills from .agents/skills; a vendored tool skill is dead weight here

contractTests: each window must carry id, kind, percentRemaining, resetsAt AND windowSeconds
Grok normalized product ids must remain product:grokbuild and product:grokimagine
a provider decoder that stops decoding must fail loudly, never emit an empty window list that reads as 'no quota pressure'
